arguments.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json
# target ~8MiB: 1000 cases x 20 data frames of 380 bytes, 8192 definitions
cases=[]
data = "A"*380
for i in range(1000):
    frames=[{"Type":"data","data_to_transfered":data,"End_Stream":True} for _ in range(20)]
    cases.append({"name":"c%d"%i,"frames":frames,"expect":{"method":"GET","target":"/","host":"h"}})
defs=[["d%d"%i,"b'%s'+'x'*%d"%('a'*80, 100)] for i in range(8192)]
parts=[{"case":"c0","data":"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h\r\n\r\n"} for _ in range(200)]
doc={"seed":"s","definitions":defs,"timeout_ms":10,"cases":cases,"events":[],
     "channels":[{"name":"e","parts":parts}]}
raw=json.dumps(doc)
print('input bytes', len(raw), 'frames', 1000*20)
json.dump(doc, open('/tmp/wide.json','w'))
PYEOF
python3 - <<'EOF'
import resource, subprocess, sys, time
t0=time.time()
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/runner.py','/workspace/project/main.py'],
                 stdin=open('/tmp/wide.json','rb'), capture_output=True, cwd='/workspace')
dt=time.time()-t0
u=resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN)
print('wall %.2fs user %.2fs sys %.2fs maxrss %dMB rc %d' % (dt,u.ru_utime,u.ru_stime,u.ru_maxrss//1024,p.returncode))
print('stderr',p.stderr[-200:]); print('out',len(p.stdout), p.stdout[:90])
EOF
